title: A Day in Tom's Life
summary: A short text about a school student's weekday routine.
body: Tom is twelve and lives in Bristol. On school days, he usually wakes up at seven o'clock. He has breakfast with his family and goes to school at eight.
After classes, Tom comes home, has a snack and does his homework. In the evening, he sometimes plays computer games or reads. He goes to bed at about ten.
questions: What time does Tom usually wake up?
What does he do after classes?
What does he sometimes do in the evening?
